00067 void EnvGenUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00068 {
00069     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00070     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00071     
00072     if(isStealing() == false && shouldSteal() == true)
00073     {
00074         setIsStealing();
00075         const int numLevels = env_.getLevels().size();
00076         float stealValue = (float)currentValue;
00077         float targetValue = env_.getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(numLevels-1);
00078         float inc = (targetValue - stealValue) / (float)numSamplesToProcess;
00079         while(numSamplesToProcess)
00080         {
00081             *outputSamples++ = stealValue;
00082             stealValue += inc;
00083             --numSamplesToProcess;
00084         }
00085         shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00086         currentValue = targetValue;
00087         currentCurve = EnvCurve(EnvCurve::Empty);
00088         setIsDone();
00089     }
00090     else
00091     {
00092         if(isReleasing() == false && shouldRelease() == true)
00093         {
00094             int releaseNode = env_.getReleaseNode();
00095 //          if(releaseNode < 0)
00096 //          {
00097 //              releaseNode = env_.getTimes().size() - 1;
00098 //          }
00099 //          
00100 //          setSegment(releaseNode, UGen::getSampleRate());
00101             
00102             if(releaseNode >= 0) // try this, - don't release if releaseNode is -1
00103             {
00104                 setSegment(releaseNode, UGen::getSampleRate());
00105             }
00106         }       
00107         
00108         while(numSamplesToProcess && isDone() == false)
00109         {
00110             int samplesThisTime = min(stepsUntilTarget, numSamplesToProcess);
00111             numSamplesToProcess -= samplesThisTime;
00112             stepsUntilTarget -= samplesThisTime;
00113             
00114             // select from different curves here..., use a different loop
00115             
00116             switch(currentCurve.getType())
00117             {
00118                 case EnvCurve::Numerical:
00119                     while(samplesThisTime)
00120                     {
00121                         *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00122                         b1 *= grow;
00123                         currentValue = a2 - b1;
00124                         --samplesThisTime;
00125                     }
00126                     break;
00127                 case EnvCurve::Linear:
00128                     while(samplesThisTime)
00129                     {
00130                         *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00131                         currentValue += grow;
00132                         --samplesThisTime;
00133                     }
00134                     break;
00135                 case EnvCurve::Exponential:
00136                     while(samplesThisTime)
00137                     {
00138                         *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00139                         currentValue *= grow;
00140                         --samplesThisTime;
00141                     }
00142                     break;
00143                 case EnvCurve::Sine:
00144                     while(samplesThisTime)
00145                     {
00146                         *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00147                         double y0 = b1 * y1 - y2; 
00148                         currentValue = a2 - y0;
00149                         y2 = y1; 
00150                         y1 = y0;
00151                         --samplesThisTime;
00152                     }
00153                     break;
00154                 case EnvCurve::Welch:
00155                     while(samplesThisTime)
00156                     {
00157                         *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00158                         double y0 = b1 * y1 - y2; 
00159                         currentValue = a2 + y0;
00160                         y2 = y1; 
00161                         y1 = y0;
00162                         --samplesThisTime;
00163                     }
00164                     break;
00165                 case EnvCurve::Empty:
00166                 case EnvCurve::Step:
00167                 default:
00168                     while(samplesThisTime)
00169                     {
00170                         *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00171                         --samplesThisTime;
00172                     }
00173             }
00174             
00175             if(stepsUntilTarget <= 0)
00176             {
00177                 if(setSegment(currentSegment + 1, UGen::getSampleRate()) == true)
00178                 {
00179                     shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00180                     const int numLevels = env_.getLevels().size();
00181                     currentValue = env_.getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(numLevels-1);
00182                     currentCurve = EnvCurve(EnvCurve::Empty);
00183                     setIsDone();
00184                     goto exit;
00185                 }
00186             }
00187         }
00188     }
00189         
00190 exit:
00191     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00192     {
00193         *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00194     }
00195 }

00207 bool EnvGenUGenInternal::setSegment(const int segment, const double stepsPerSecond) throw()
00208 {   
00209     ugen_assert(stepsPerSecond > 0.0);
00210     
00211     if(segment == env_.getReleaseNode())
00212     {   
00213         if(shouldRelease() == true)
00214         {
00215             currentSegment = segment;
00216             setIsReleasing();
00217         } 
00218         else
00219         {
00220             const int loopNode = env_.getLoopNode();
00221             if(loopNode < 0)
00222             {
00223                 currentCurve = EnvCurve(EnvCurve::Empty);
00224                 stepsUntilTarget = 0x7FFFFFFF; // very large !
00225                 return false;
00226             }
00227             else
00228             {
00229                 currentSegment = loopNode;
00230                 currentValue = env_.getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(currentSegment);
00231             }
00232         }
00233     }
00234     else
00235     {
00236         currentSegment = segment;
00237     }
00238     
00239     const int numSegments = env_.getTimes().size();
00240     if(currentSegment >= numSegments) return true; // env done
00241     
00242     double targetTime = env_.getTimes().getSampleUnchecked(currentSegment);
00243     double targetValue = env_.getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(currentSegment + 1);
00244     
00245     stepsUntilTarget = (int)(stepsPerSecond * targetTime);
00246     if(stepsUntilTarget < 1) 
00247     {
00248         stepsUntilTarget = 1;
00249         currentCurve = EnvCurve(EnvCurve::Linear);
00250     }
00251     else
00252         currentCurve = env_.getCurves()[currentSegment];
00253     
00254     double w, curveValue;
00255     switch(currentCurve.getType())
00256     {
00257         case EnvCurve::Numerical:
00258             curveValue = currentCurve.getCurve();
00259             if(std::fabs(curveValue) > 0.001)
00260             {
00261                 double a1 = (targetValue - currentValue) / (1.0 - std::exp(curveValue));    
00262                 a2 = currentValue + a1;
00263                 b1 = a1; 
00264                 grow = std::exp(curveValue / (double)stepsUntilTarget);
00265                 break;
00266             }
00267             else
00268             {   
00269                 currentCurve = EnvCurve(EnvCurve::Linear);
00270                 // fall through to the next case..
00271             }
00272         case EnvCurve::Linear:
00273             grow = (targetValue - currentValue) / (double)stepsUntilTarget;
00274             break;
00275         case EnvCurve::Exponential:
00276             grow = std::pow(targetValue / currentValue, 1.0 / (double)stepsUntilTarget);
00277             break;
00278         case EnvCurve::Sine:
00279             w = pi / (double)stepsUntilTarget;
00280             
00281             a2 = (targetValue + currentValue) * 0.5;
00282             b1 = 2.0 * std::cos(w);
00283             y1 = (targetValue - currentValue) * 0.5;
00284             y2 = y1 * std::sin(pi2 - w);
00285             currentValue = a2 - y1;
00286             
00287             break;
00288         case EnvCurve::Welch:
00289             w = pi2 / (double)stepsUntilTarget;
00290             
00291             b1 = 2.0 * std::cos(w);
00292             
00293             if (targetValue >= currentValue) 
00294             {
00295                 a2 = currentValue;
00296                 y1 = 0.;
00297                 y2 = -std::sin(w) * (targetValue - currentValue);
00298             } 
00299             else 
00300             {
00301                 a2 = targetValue;
00302                 y1 = currentValue - targetValue;
00303                 y2 = std::cos(w) * (currentValue - targetValue);
00304             }
00305             
00306             currentValue = a2 + y1;
00307             
00308             break;
00309         case EnvCurve::Empty:
00310         case EnvCurve::Step:
00311         default:
00312             currentValue = targetValue;
00313     }
00314     
00315     return false; // ready for next segment
00316 }

00325 void EnvGenUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00326 {
00327     const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00328     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00329     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00330     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00331     
00332     int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00333     
00334     double prevValue = currentValue;
00335     
00336     if(isDone()) goto exit;
00337 
00338     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00339     {
00340         prevValue = currentValue;
00341         if(numKrSamples == 0)
00342         {
00343             if(isStealing() == false && shouldSteal() == true)
00344             {
00345                 setIsStealing();
00346                 const int numLevels = env_.getLevels().size();
00347                 float stealValue = (float)currentValue;
00348                 float targetValue = env_.getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(numLevels-1);
00349                 float inc = (targetValue - stealValue) / (float)numSamplesToProcess;
00350                 while(numSamplesToProcess)
00351                 {
00352                     *outputSamples++ = stealValue;
00353                     stealValue += inc;
00354                     --numSamplesToProcess;
00355                 }
00356                 shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00357                 currentValue = targetValue;
00358                 currentCurve = EnvCurve(EnvCurve::Empty);
00359                 setIsDone();
00360                 return;
00361             }
00362             else
00363             {
00364                 if(isReleasing() == false && shouldRelease() == true)
00365                 {
00366                     int releaseNode = env_.getReleaseNode();
00367 //                  if(releaseNode < 0)
00368 //                  {
00369 //                      releaseNode = env_.getTimes().size() - 1;
00370 //                  }
00371 //                  
00372 //                  setSegment(releaseNode, UGen::getSampleRate() / krBlockSize);
00373                     
00374                     if(releaseNode >= 0) // try this..
00375                     {
00376                         setSegment(releaseNode, UGen::getSampleRate() / krBlockSize);
00377                     }
00378                 }       
00379                 
00380                 --stepsUntilTarget;
00381                                     
00382                 double y0;
00383                 switch(currentCurve.getType())
00384                 {
00385                     case EnvCurve::Numerical:
00386                         currentValue = a2 - b1;
00387                         b1 *= grow;
00388                         break;
00389                     case EnvCurve::Linear:
00390                         currentValue += grow;
00391                         break;
00392                     case EnvCurve::Exponential:
00393                         currentValue *= grow;
00394                         break;
00395                     case EnvCurve::Sine:
00396                         y0 = b1 * y1 - y2; 
00397                         currentValue = a2 - y0;
00398                         y2 = y1; y1 = y0;
00399                         break;
00400                     case EnvCurve::Welch:
00401                         y0 = b1 * y1 - y2; 
00402                         currentValue = a2 + y0;
00403                         y2 = y1; y1 = y0;
00404                         break;
00405                     case EnvCurve::Empty:
00406                     case EnvCurve::Step:
00407                     default:
00408                         ;
00409                 }
00410                 
00411                 if(stepsUntilTarget <= 0)
00412                 {
00413                     if(setSegment(currentSegment + 1, UGen::getSampleRate() / krBlockSize) == true)
00414                     {
00415                         shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00416                         const int numLevels = env_.getLevels().size();
00417                         currentValue = env_.getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(numLevels-1);
00418                         currentCurve = EnvCurve(EnvCurve::Empty);
00419                         goto exit;
00420                     }
00421                 }
00422                 
00423             }
00424         }
00425         
00426         numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00427         blockPosition += numKrSamples;
00428         
00429         if(prevValue == currentValue)
00430         {
00431             while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00432             {
00433                 *outputSamples++ = (float)prevValue;
00434                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00435                 --numKrSamples;
00436             }
00437         }
00438         else
00439         {
00440             double valueSlope = (currentValue - prevValue) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();
00441             while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00442             {
00443                 *outputSamples++ = (float)prevValue;
00444                 prevValue += valueSlope;
00445                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00446                 --numKrSamples;
00447             }
00448         }
00449     }       
00450     
00451     return;
00452 
00453 exit:
00454     
00455     if(prevValue == currentValue)
00456     {
00457         while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00458         {
00459             *outputSamples++ = (float)prevValue;
00460             --numSamplesToProcess;
00461         }
00462     }
00463     else
00464     {
00465         double valueSlope = (currentValue - prevValue) / (double)numSamplesToProcess;
00466         while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00467         {
00468             *outputSamples++ = (float)prevValue;
00469             prevValue += valueSlope;
00470             --numSamplesToProcess;
00471         }
00472     }
00473     
00474     setIsDone();
00475 }
